test_title: PYST 21: SSC GD Constable 2024 - Reasoning (Held On: 26 Feb, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: Five friends P, B, C, G and H are sitting around a circular table facing towards the centre. H is sitting to the immediate right of C. B sitting third to the left of H. P is not an immediate neighbour of C. Who is sitting on the immediate right of G?
solution:
Given: Five friends P, B, C, G and H..

1) H is sitting to the immediate right of C.

2) B sitting third to the left of H.

3) P is not an immediate neighbour of C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/459b366ebbb16c40713e6718d4d6bbd90b0f28247b25163a3845fa57e61f20bb.png] 

So, **C** is sitting on the immediate right of G.

Hence, the correct answer is** "Option 3".**
